metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a single standard-library Python CLI at [main.py](/workspace/output/main.py) with wrapper binary [iges](/workspace/output/iges).

Supported commands:

- `iges parse --input <file.iges> --output <out.json>`
- `iges write --input <file.json> --output <out.iges>`
- `iges query --input <file.iges> --de <n> --output <entity.json>`
- `iges eval --input <file.iges> --de <n> --t <f> [--s <f>] --output <point.json>`
- `iges roundtrip --input <file.iges> --output <out.iges>`

What’s included:

- Fixed-format 80-column IGES section parsing/writing (`S/G/D/P/T`)
- Global section delimiter/Hollerith parsing, default handling, clamping for `spec_version`
- Directory Entry parsing/validation (including `view`, `xform_matrix`, `label_display`)
- Canonical JSON emission with diagnostic envelope on input errors
- Writer that regenerates DE pointers/counts and P-section back-pointers
- Entity decoding/encoding for core geometric/eval entities (including 100/102/104/106/110/112/114/116/118/120/122/123/124/126/128/130/140/190/192/194/196/198) plus raw-field lossless fallback for remaining catalog entities
- `eval` for required curve/surface families with transformation-matrix application order

Validation performed:

- `python -m py_compile /workspace/output/main.py`
- CLI smoke run for `write -> parse -> eval` on a generated IGES model

Run it as:

```bash
python /workspace/output/main.py <subcommand> ...
```

or:

```bash
/workspace/output/iges <subcommand> ...
```
